title: Dos and Don’ts / type colors
slide_intent: Protect a consistent text hierarchy so decorative coloring does not compete with the message.
strategic_value: Neutral campaign text can keep DB’s red and Lilac accents visually distinct.
demonstration: Accepted neutral-text layouts sit beside a crossed-out multicolored headline example.
practical_value: Use the stated standard text colors and check the separate UI accessibility exception before applying this rule broadly.

content_islands.name: Typography comparison
content_islands.spec: Compare accepted Black/White text and the stated Cold Black headline option with the crossed-out colored wording.

reference_purposes.Application: The paired compositions compare neutral and colored typography.
reference_purposes.Constraint: This section lists Black/White as standard text colors, Cold Black only for expressive headlines, and prohibits Lilac/DB Red text in its general wording.

ingredient.name: Standard typography color
ingredient.role: Keep text clear and separate from expressive accents.
ingredient.application: Use Black or White; this do/don’t allows Cold Black only for expressive headlines.
ingredient.scope: The wording prohibits DB Red text generally, while the preceding accessibility section explicitly permits red links, warnings and notices. Preserve that source qualification rather than erase it.
